Redragon M808‑KS Storm Pro Wireless Gaming Mouse – Specifications (English)

General

  • Type: Wireless / Wired Gaming Mouse

  • Connectivity: 2.4 GHz Wireless + USB Wired (Dual Mode)

  • Design: Lightweight Honeycomb Shell

  • Color: Black / White

  • Weight: ≈96 g

  • Dimensions: 126.8 × 65.5 × 41 mm 

Sensor & Performance

  • Sensor: Pixart PAW3335 Optical Sensor

  • DPI Range: 100 – 16,000 DPI (adjustable)

  • Polling Rate: 125 / 250 / 500 / 1000 Hz

  • Acceleration: 40G

  • Tracking: High-precision optical tracking for gaming 

Buttons & Switches

  • Buttons: 8 Programmable Buttons (including wheel click)

  • Main Switches: Huano Mechanical Switches

  • Switch Durability: Up to 20 Million Clicks 

Lighting

  • RGB Backlighting

  • Customizable lighting effects via software

Battery

  • Built-in Rechargeable Li-ion Battery

  • Long battery life with power-saving mode 

Cable

  • 1.8 m Braided USB Cable (for wired mode & charging) 

Software

  • Dedicated software for:

    • DPI adjustment

    • Macro programming

    • RGB customization

    • Button remapping 

Compatibility

  • Windows XP / Vista / 7 / 8 / 10 / 11

  • PC & Laptop 

✅ Key Features

  • Ultra-lightweight gaming mouse

  • Dual mode (wireless + wired)

  • Honeycomb design for better airflow and lighter weight

  • High-precision gaming sensor up to 16K DPI
